global.title: Amidst fears of AI cyberattacks, Satya Nadella says lots of critical infrastructure is ‘unpatchable’
global.summary: The Microsoft CEO downplayed the recent Outlook outage while noting that AI was causing both opportunities and new challenges for securing much of the connected world.
global.titleKo: AI 사이버공격 우려 속 사티아 나델라 "상당수 핵심 인프라는 패치 불가능"
global.summaryKo: 마이크로소프트 CEO 사티아 나델라가 최근 Outlook 장애를 대수롭지 않게 평가하면서, AI가 연결된 세계의 보안에 기회와 새로운 과제를 함께 가져오고 있다고 말했다.
global.summaryEn: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella downplayed the recent Outlook outage and said AI is creating both opportunities and new challenges for securing the connected world.

global.title: Even His Own Officials Don’t Think Trump’s China Trip Will Lead to Progress on AI
global.summary: Fallout from the Nvidia scandal has made any negotiations around AI difficult, officials say.
global.titleKo: 트럼프 행정부 관리들조차 "방중으로 AI 협상 진전 어려워"
global.summaryKo: 관리들에 따르면 엔비디아 스캔들의 여파로 트럼프 대통령의 중국 방문 중 AI 관련 협상이 어려워진 상황이다.
global.summaryEn: Administration officials say fallout from the Nvidia scandal has made AI negotiations difficult, leaving little expectation of progress from Trump's China visit.
